usage: 橙色 is a noun for the colour orange. It is commonly used before nouns, for example 橙色衫 or 橙色鞋.
In everyday speech, people often shorten it to 橙, but 橙色 sounds more neutral and clear when talking about colour.
It can be used for both bright orange and softer orange shades, depending on context.
When describing something, 橙色 usually appears as a colour word, not as a verb or adjective.
